Environmental consultant with 8 years of experience across Asia-Pacific and Europe, combining field-based impact assessment, transaction due diligence and climate advisory with a strong quantitative toolkit (R, GIS, WindPro). Experienced in supporting clients in alignment with IFC Performance Standards, ADB Safeguards, Equator Principles (EP4) and ISO frameworks.
